blocks.text: Why legal assistants use Slack on Mac

Law firms often deal with high volumes of fragmented information. Slack provides a central hub for case updates, internal queries, and document sharing. When you use Slack for legal assistants on Mac, you gain a distinct advantage by pairing the app with macOS system features. You can keep Slack in a dedicated space or use split view to keep your practice management software like Clio open alongside your team chat.
Essential Slack keyboard shortcuts for Mac

Efficiency in a law firm comes down to how fast you move between tasks. If you are using Slack for legal assistants on Mac, your fingers should stay on the keyboard. Press Command + / to see the full list of shortcuts inside the app. Here are the ones you will use most often.

items: Command + K: Open the Quick Switcher to jump to any channel or direct message.
Command + G: Open the search bar to find files or past conversations.
Command + ,: Open your preferences to adjust notification schedules.
Shift + Enter: Add a line break to your message instead of sending it.
Command + B: Bold text to highlight critical dates or deadlines in your messages.

blocks.text: Legal assistants often juggle multiple active matters. Create a specific naming convention for your channels, such as #matter-1234-client-name. This keeps your sidebar clean and prevents you from posting in the wrong workspace. If you need to find a specific document shared by an attorney, use search modifiers. Type in:channel-name has:file to narrow down your results to a specific conversation.

Sometimes you forget where a specific setting is hidden. Instead of clicking through menus, hold Option + Command and ask Lazur where to find a feature. Lazur will point at the screen and highlight the exact button you need. If you are drafting a long response to an attorney, hold the fn key to dictate your text. This helps you get your thoughts down quickly before you move to the next task.

Performance issues can interrupt your billable work. If Slack feels sluggish or fails to load new messages, try clearing the cache. Go to the menu bar and select Help > Troubleshooting > Clear Cache and Restart. This is a common fix for Mac users experiencing sync delays. Always ensure you are on the latest version of macOS, as Slack requires macOS 14 or higher for full support.

Administrative work takes up a large portion of your day. By using Slack for legal assistants on Mac effectively, you can reduce the time spent on internal questions. Use threads to keep discussions organized. This ensures that case-specific questions stay attached to the relevant document or matter. If you find yourself typing the same answers repeatedly, consider creating a snippet or using a text expander tool to save time.

Privacy is non-negotiable in legal work. Review your Slack preferences frequently. Check your notification settings to ensure you are not displaying sensitive client information in your desktop alerts. Go to Preferences > Notifications and toggle off the preview of message text if you work in a shared office space. This simple step protects client confidentiality while keeping you informed of urgent updates.

Constant pings can break your concentration during document review. Use the built-in Do Not Disturb feature to pause alerts during deep work sessions. You can access this by clicking your profile photo or by typing /dnd in the message field. Setting a schedule ensures that you are not interrupted after hours. Maintaining boundaries is key to a sustainable workflow in a demanding legal environment.

faq.question: How do I find a specific file in Slack?
faq.answer: Use the search bar with the modifier has:file. You can also add from:user-name to find files sent by a specific attorney.

faq.question: Can I use Slack on older Macs?
faq.answer: Slack requires macOS 14 or higher. If your Mac cannot run this version, you may need to use the browser-based version of Slack.

faq.question: How do I jump to a channel quickly?
faq.answer: Press Command + K on your keyboard to open the Quick Switcher, then type the name of the channel you want to enter.
